messages:
Maya: quick sync — staging q6b-int4 shows a ~3% ROUGE-L regression on the long-form summarization promptset (longsumm_v3). Can we assemble an edgecase promptset and refresh the golden?
Ravi: where did you spot the 3% delta? dashboard or local runs?
Maya: dashboard -> /dashboards/infra/quant-compare. filtered model=q6b-int4 baseline=q6b-fp16 dataset=longsumm_v3. I exported failing ids: s3://redwood-qa/q6b-int4/longsumm_v3/failures_2026-03-20.csv
Elena: I can run a focused eval over the candidate prompts. Use the quant-compare harness locally:
```
python infra/eval/quant_compare.py --model q6b-int4 --baseline q6b-fp16 \
  --prompts data/promptsets/longsumm_v3.jsonl --out /tmp/qcomp.jsonl --seed 42
```
This will collect generations + metrics.
Jon: FYI label-ops — golden refresh needs ~200 curated golds (50 edgecases + 150 anchors). Current labeler throughput ~30/day unless we bump priority. @Maya how much slack do we have?
Maya: release canary Wed. 200 by Tue EOD ideal. If not possible, we can accept a 75-item microgolden for the canary.
Ravi: many failures look like paraphrase/near-duplicates. I'll run fuzzy dedupe before labeling: `tools/curation/dedupe.py --input failures.csv --threshold 0.82 --out failures_dedup.csv`
Elena: also flagging tokenizer drift — q6b-int4 uses tokenizer v2 which truncates some long inputs differently vs fp16. I'll diff token counts and post examples.
ci-bot: test:quant-compare q6b-int4 vs q6b-fp16 — 2026-03-20T14:12:08Z — failures=312 / 10000 mean_delta=-0.031
Jon: golden selection plan: 50 highest-roge-drop failures + 25 paraphrase cluster reps + 25 low-frequency intents. I'll make a sheet and tag items with needs-dedupe / needs-deid.
Maya: action items: (1) @Ravi run dedupe and upload failures_dedup.csv by EOD (2) @Elena post tokenizer-diff top20 (3) @Jon create golden sheet and request microgolden if labelers can't scale. I'll re-run the harness after dedupe. :thumbsup:
Ravi: starting dedupe job, ETA ~3h. Will upload to s3 and ping.
Elena: tokenizer diffs uploaded: s3://redwood-qa/q6b-int4/tokenizer-diffs/2026-03-20/ — found 18 truncation mismatches, 6 overlap high-delta failures.
Maya: if truncation + duplicates explain most regressions we can patch tokenizer mapping and tweak quant kernels. Otherwise we escalate to quant team for deeper profiling.
Jon: spreadsheet posted and labelers asked to block 48h. internal link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/golden/QA-987 (private)
ci-bot: deploy:staging q6b-int4 — metrics snapshot saved to /artifacts/q6b-int4/2026-03-20-14-45.json
Maya: closing loop — please add adversarial candidates to the longsumm-regen thread in prompt-curation. I'll re-run comparisons once dedupe output is in. Thanks all.
